utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday, 26 January. Can you all hear me? Teams has picked the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, loud enough. Whose new car is that in the car park? Takes up about a bay and a half.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's just your parking making everything else look crooked.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Cheers. Also, there's a birthday cake in the office. Proper one, not those individually wrapped bits of sadness.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: You've done a thorough handover of the important stuff, then.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Meanwhile the heating in the portakabin's either tropical or off. I'm sat here in a fleece with the door open. Just moaning, before anyone writes that down.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Very energy efficient, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a facilities podcast. Finished work first, then what we're actually agreeing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, so I signed off the inspection on the Gas Turbine 1 on Tuesday. That's complete, nothing outstanding from that inspection.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, just so the notes make sense?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Last Tuesday, yeah. Not something for today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same sort of update from me: signed off the inspection on the palletizer on Tuesday. Closed out.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I tested the line 2 robot yesterday and it's all fine now. That one's done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, it's been behaving. Nice to have one thing behaving.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any shift observations? Keep those separate from jobs, please.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I saw the pressure on the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Stayed back up afterwards, did it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah. Just passing on what happened, not asking for work on it today.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Similar thing, I noticed the outfeed conveyor was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: So that's an observation as well, not another repair being booked in?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Exactly. It settled. Nothing new from me on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: The other thing is we can't get to the gas turbine two until production gives us a window. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. No work on that being agreed while there's no window.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the main water valve. That's still blocked their end.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. No confirmed delivery, no new commitment on that this morning.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's it. It's a status update, unfortunately, not good news.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Dave, can you replace the seals on the IM1 hydraulic unit by end of day? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, um—this is the seals job, not the pressure dip we just mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, different unit. The IM1 hydraulic unit is the one holding us up.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Got you. I'll replace the seals on the IM1 hydraulic unit first, and have that done by end of day.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you do a site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor by 11am? No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: By 11am for the visit, yeah? Not eleven as a departure time?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, the site visit by 11am. No rush, it's not an emergency.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Okay, agreed. I'll do the site visit at Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Aisha, can you go to the water works to pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 chiller? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll go to the water works and pick up the replacement parts for the line 3 chiller. Understood, important but not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just so those don't get bundled together in the notes, that's separate from the main water valve delivery I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, separate thing. I'm talking about the line 3 chiller parts.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Anything to put against the Forklift Fleet pre-use checks?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet first thing tomorrow. It's urgent, so that's first thing, not whenever I get a gap.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Tomorrow being Tuesday morning, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, Tuesday, first thing tomorrow. That's what I'm committing to.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie Brennan. Got you against the Forklift Fleet checks, urgent, first thing tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you swap the filter on the CT1 at half two? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that. I can't leave the CHP at half two, so don't put it against me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Jamie, can you take that instead? Swap the filter on the CT1 at half two. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I can take that instead. I'll swap the filter on the CT1 at half two.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Thanks. Didn't want to say yes and then have everyone wondering where I'd got to.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, fair enough. Half two, understood. It won't get shuffled off as an emergency-only job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: There's also spare parts to order for the pick and place on two. Needs doing by 11am, but it's low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I can't take that order on as well. Don't stick my name on it just because it's parts.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't pick that one up either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone else taking the spare parts order for the pick and place on two? No? Okay, nobody owns it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, crossed audio there—did you say low priority, even with the eleven deadline?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, low priority. The order is needed by 11am, but I'm raising the need, not volunteering to do it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that stays unassigned. We haven't agreed an owner, so let's not make the notes look as though somebody accepted it.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And my first job is the seals on the IM1 hydraulic unit. End of day for completion. Clear on that.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'm clear too. Kestrel in Leeds with the contractor by 11am, then the separate parts pickup we've agreed. No deadline added to that pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Mine are the CT1 filter at half two, and the Forklift Fleet pre-use checks first thing tomorrow. Two different days, before Teams makes a lovely mess of it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. And the pick and place on two order is still nobody's, low priority, needed by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nothing else from production. The pressure dip was just an observation and the gas turbine two is still blocked, not in today's agreed work.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Nothing else here. My inspection update was a completed sign-off, so that's all from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same. And the portakabin commentary was not a formal request for a new heating system.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Good, because the cake budget's clearly taken all the capital spend.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, on that highly technical note, we're done. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Cheers.
